name: Knott's Ghost Town Bakery & Farm Bakery Snoopy Sugar Cookie, Plain Croissant or Warm Cinnamon Roll
brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Bakery & Farm Bakery (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Fresh-baked butter croissants, soft Snoopy sugar cookies, and warm cinnamon rolls are 100% free of boysenberry seeds, nuts, and roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose a plain Butter Croissant, a Snoopy Shortbread/Sugar Cookie, or share the soft center of a warm Cinnamon Roll (avoid whole-berry Boysenberry Turnovers and Boysenberry Pie slices).
watchOuts: Skip turnovers and pies filled with whole seeded boysenberries
